facts.fact: L'Interview reports that access to information in Togo is governed chiefly by Law no. 2016-006 of 30 March 2016 on freedom of access to public information and documentation, which sets reply deadlines, appeal procedures and sanctions for obstructing officials.
L'Interview reports that the decree setting the law's implementing arrangements (decree no. 2017-104/PR) was adopted by the Council of Ministers on 5 May 2017.

TGO.note: The document says nothing on civil-service digital skills training.

facts.fact: L'Interview lists a 2019 personal data protection law among the texts that, with Law 2016-006, govern the right to information in Togo.
facts.system: Loi sur la protection des donnees personnelles (2019)

systems.system: Loi sur la protection des donnees personnelles (2019)

TGO.note: The document reports a forum on the access to information law and states no cut, punishment, repeal or bar on cuts.
